column3: “Righteousness” is joined to the calling: “Whom He calls in righteousness.”
“Do not fear” (second) is rendered “Do not anxiously look about you,” and “I have strengthened” as future “I will strengthen.”
“I will make you” is rendered “I have made you,” and “owner of teeth” as “with double edges.”
“Tree of oil” is rendered “olive tree,” and “elm” as “juniper.”
“Officials” is rendered “rulers,” and “like mud” as “as upon mortar.”
“A first one to Zion” is rendered “Formerly I said to Zion”; the meaning is uncertain.
